methods.optimizationSnapshotSourceDigest: SHA-256 of the sorted sha256sum manifest for src-tauri/src, src/renderer, benchmark inputs and non-optimization benchmark records, Cargo/build/Tauri manifests, package.json, bun.lock, and presets.json; optimization-*.json outputs excluded. This historical digest identifies the source used to select Candidate A.
methods.postParitySourceDigest: SHA-256 of the sorted sha256sum manifest for application and Tauri source/config/capabilities, Cargo/Bun/frontend metadata, workflows and packaging scripts/artwork, release documentation, website/wiki source, and benchmark inputs/non-optimization records; optimization-*.json outputs excluded. This digest identifies the later fully accepted source and evidence refresh.
methods.postParitySourceDigestCommand: find .github/workflows 'Release Notes' benchmarks bo3-enhanced-proton installer scripts src src-tauri/src src-tauri/capabilities src-tauri/gen website wiki README.md PatchOpsIII.ico bun.lock package.json presets.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts src-tauri/Cargo.toml src-tauri/Cargo.lock src-tauri/build.rs src-tauri/tauri.conf.json -type f ! -name 'optimization-*.json' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
methods.cleanBuild: Fresh isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR; downloaded crate and system-library caches retained; three serialized runs; seconds are shell monotonic wall time.
methods.noChangeBuild: Five serialized cargo build --release --locked invocations after one unrecorded normalization build; milliseconds are Bun monotonic wall time. This preserves the existing release-no-change methodology and is not a one-source-file rebuild.
methods.runtime: Pre-extracted AppImage; one unrecorded prime; per-run isolated HOME/XDG directories and fixed Steam/settings fixture; five warm runs, three payload-cold runs, three 30-second CPU samples; native WM_DELETE_WINDOW shutdown.
methods.operations: Optimized Rust test helper; fixed 256 MiB executable fixture; payload-cold advice before cold hashes; fresh deterministic 4 MiB Deflate ZIP and tar.gz extraction destinations; prepared offline T7, DXVK, Enhanced, and Linux compatibility transaction-core fixtures; validation, restoration assertions, and cleanup outside timed regions.
methods.appDirHostAdjustment: For the profile-selection snapshot, the custom local sysroot's AppImage bundler omitted four WebKit subprocess/injected-bundle files. The same four required files were copied into every measured AppDir; MiniBrowser and jsc were not copied. Compressed AppImage bytes are unmodified.
methods.runtimePairing: Long-running host state shifted WebKit memory and renderer timing materially. Profile selection compares its final run to a baseline run primed and recorded immediately afterward in the same lower-memory regime. Earlier raw runs remain below as drift evidence.

A.decision: selected profile; all paired runtime and operation gates passed

B.decision: rejected: paired idle PSS and RSS were 2.5% and 3.5% above baseline, and the AppImage was only 61440 bytes smaller than A

C.precedingProfile: A; B failed the memory gate
C.decision: rejected: warm interactive startup regressed 53.0%, payload-cold startup regressed 42.5%, and 256 MiB hashing regressed more than 330%

final.dependencyChange: Removed the unused direct zstd declaration; retained zip deflate, bzip2, and zstd features.

artifacts.debHashLimitation: The checked-in workflow repacks the beta control version and computes the release hash. This host lacks dpkg-deb, so the exact local hash is for the structurally inspected pre-canonicalization Tauri package and will differ from the CI release package.

postParityRefresh.scope: Fresh measurements and artifact hashes after the legacy-compatibility, rollback, security, packaging, and release-parity work. The selected Thin-LTO profile and dependency decision did not change; the historical final block above remains the evidence used to select it. final-tauri.json retains every raw timing sample.

validation.externalGates: Actual MSI authoring/upgrade, canonical Debian lifecycle, hosted Ubuntu/Arch smokes, and physical Steam Deck validation require their corresponding runners or hardware.

exactCurrentOperationRefresh.method: Same-host exact-current refresh. Each release-profile variant received one unrecorded normalization run followed by one serialized recorded run. The fixed fixture contains a physically written 256 MiB BlackOps3.exe with SHA-256 a6d72ac7690f53be6ae46ba88506bd97302a093f7108472bd9efc3cefda06484. Prepared deterministic payloads exercise production T7, DXVK, Enhanced, and Linux compatibility transaction cores; seven raw samples per transaction metric and their medians are retained. Download/current-release lookup, the application-global mutation lock, command logging, real HOME/Steam discovery, and process control are excluded. Correctness and restoration assertions run outside timed regions.

ubuntu2204NativeRelease.comparisonCaveat: Ubuntu-native AppImage and AppDir sizes are not attributed to Rust-profile savings relative to the CachyOS host artifacts because distribution library builds and dependency closures differ. The canonical Debian package is smaller by moving WebKitGTK/GTK into declared system dependencies, not by deleting them from the portable AppImage.

dependencyAndClosureAudit.decision: No bundled library was removed. Static DT_NEEDED analysis cannot prove runtime-loaded WebKit, GTK, GIO, image, input, TLS, or helper modules unreachable.

limitations: Local AppImage smoke covered window creation, the renderer-to-Rust get_state path (including fixture Steam detection), images rendered by the main UI, and native clean shutdown. Network download latency is deliberately excluded from the reproducible benchmark.
The exact-current Ubuntu AppImage smoke passed. The final official Arch root smoke reached WebKit but did not pass because the controlled Xvfb environment could not create an EGL display.
The exact-current Debian install/upgrade/purge rerun did not complete; only the earlier provisional old/current package GUI smokes have completion markers.
A real Steam Deck and real Windows MSI authoring/upgrade run remain external-runner gates.
The local sysroot required NO_STRIP=1 for AppImage bundling; Rust symbol stripping still applies to the selected release profile.
